text:
alex.k: Heads up — kicking off the A/B rollout for reranker_v3 now. Noticed potential audience overlap in the sampling table, can someone confirm dedupe logic?

maria_g: Thanks — looking. Quick grep shows `audience_v2_legacy=true` still in one rule which can cause cookie+userid double-assign (~0.7% per quick scan).

devon: We should enforce a primary-key priority so a user only gets one bucket. Proposal: `split.primary_key=user_id` with cookie as fallback.

samir: If overlap >0.5% we should shrink the active canary to 0.5% until fixed. Also, do we have metric guards in place?

alex.k: Metrics are noisy but no big regressions so far (CTR +0.3pp). I'll cap growth at 1% and pause any automatic increase.

julie: @ops-bot can you add a guardrail rule: auto-pause if `err_rate > 0.5%` for 5m and notify #incidents?

ops-bot: rule add acknowledged — `reranker_v3_guardrail_err > 0.005 for 5m => notify #incidents and pause-toggle` :white_check_mark:

maria_g: Pushed a candidate config change to remove the legacy flag. Config snippet:
```
audience:
  id: rerank_ab
  primary_key: user_id
  splits:
    - control: 50
    - treatment: 50
filters:
  - exclude: legacy_cookie_bucket
```

devon: Nice. I also want a pre-deploy check in CI that fails if `overlap_score > 0.2%`. I'll add `./scripts/check_overlap.sh rerank_ab` to the pipeline.

alex.k: And document fallback behavior: if overlap persists, use deterministic hash: `user_id % 100 < 1` for 1% canary and route rest to control.

samir: Running offline overlap calc on last 7 days now, will post numbers.

ops-bot: overlap job finished — Overlap=0.12% over 7d (unique users), sampling entropy OK. dashboard: https://internal.metrics/overlap/1867504321

alex.k: Good to see it's under the 0.2% threshold. Action items: maria verify config in staging + open PR, devon add overlap check to CI, samir schedule weekly overlap run and post, i'll hold rollout at 1% until staging sign-off.

maria_g: On it — will open the PR and deploy to staging in ~30m. :rocket:

devon: I'll prep the CI change and queue a small test job.

samir: I'll add the weekly job to my calendar and paste results into this thread each Monday.

alex.k: Thanks team. If anyone sees overlap creep after staging, tag me and I'll pause the toggle immediately. :thumbsup:
